title: 😡Extremely poor experience and an unprofessional update
body:
The new ADCB app is the worst user experience I have ever had. The app is full of bugs and glitches that make daily use impossible.
To this day, I cannot make any money transfers, pay bills, or even change or modify basic options within the app. Most buttons and options are completely non-responsive; for example, I cannot select the "transfer reason" or change the card I want to pay bills from, not to mention a long list of other technical issues.
It is completely unprofessional to discontinue the old app and force customers to switch to the new one without testing it thoroughly and ensuring it works efficiently. What happened has disrupted customers' interests and caused a major decline in service quality. I hope these disastrous issues are fixed immediately, or that the option to revert to the old app is provided until the bugs are resolved.

title: Lost access to old ADCB Application
body:

If the new application is still being developed, the old one should remain accessible for some time until user become familiar with the new version

Additionally, the app seems heavily focused on AI features, which are already everywhere, banking applications should prioritize simple and efficient money transfers, account management, and card controls.. not everything is about AI

title: Efficient Mobile Banking App with Modern Dark Design
body: The mobile banking app provides a smooth and efficient user experience. Its dark mode design is visually appealing and easy on the eyes, especially during nighttime use. It also offers a wide range of features, giving users more options to manage their finances, such as transfers, bill payments, and account monitoring. Overall, it is a reliable and well-designed mobile banking platform that combines speed, functionality, and modern aesthetics.

title: Horrendous
body:
I genuinely did not think it was possible for an app update to make an experience worse than before, but this latest version has managed to do exactly that.

The previous version had genuinely useful features that made managing finances straightforward and user-friendly. Now, many of those features are either gone or buried behind a much less intuitive interface. The user experience has clearly regressed.

One of the most frustrating changes is the removal of the ability to easily hide and unhide balances — a simple but very practical feature that many users relied on for privacy and convenience.

The credit card section has also taken a major step backwards. Previously, there were clear and detailed breakdowns showing statement amounts, minimum payments, and the exact amount needed to avoid penalties or interest charges. That information was extremely useful for responsible financial management. Now, those details are either difficult to find or no longer available at all.

Overall, the app feels less functional, less user-friendly, and more frustrating to use than before. Instead of improving on what already worked well, the update seems to have removed practical features that users actually valued.
author: Muna.zw

reply.body:
Hello, we’re sorry to hear about your experience. To mask or unmask your balance, please tap the “eye” icon at the top of the home screen. On the card page, the Statement Overview provides a summary and a clear overview of your payments. For more detailed information, you can access the statement section within the card page. Rest assured, your feedback has been shared with the concerned team for review.
R.B

body:
I am extremely disappointed with the ADCB deposit machine at Al Ain Mall. This has happened to me and several of my colleagues multiple times: whenever we need to deposit money, the machine is either out of service or becomes jammed after accepting our cash.

The most frustrating part is when the machine takes the money but fails to process the transaction. Customers are then left waiting anxiously, wondering whether their hard-earned money is safe. Every time I contact customer service, I receive the same response—to wait 48 hours while a concern is raised. There is never any immediate reassurance or guarantee that the issue will be resolved without complications.

While the ADCB app has improved over time, the deposit machines continue to be unreliable. It is difficult to understand why such a common problem keeps occurring without a permanent solution. Unfortunately, the only thing that seems to work consistently is the monthly charges and fees being deducted from customers’ accounts.

A bank should provide reliable banking services and peace of mind, not unnecessary stress every time customers need to make a simple cash deposit. I sincerely hope ADCB takes this issue seriously and improves the reliability of its machines, especially at Al Ain Mall.
author: nairajoy

reply.body:
We understand your frustration. While some features within the Mobile Banking app were affected, the issue extended beyond the app itself and was not caused by it. In the meantime, you can continue to access and manage your accounts through the ADCB Internet Banking portal by visiting adcb.com/login, and we recommend using a desktop browser for the best experience. 
K.A

I expected much better support and reliability from ADCB, especially when I urgently need access to my own money. This experience has been extremely disappointing.i want this issue to be fixed immediately. The chat bot doesn’t work too, what is this??

title: Unacceptable Banking App Experience
body:
It’s been over a week, and I’m still unable to send money or use many of the app’s essential features. This has affected my monthly payments and caused significant inconvenience. Even my ADCB Apple Wallet wasn’t working despite having sufficient funds in my account.

The previous version of the app was much better and far more user-friendly. Before releasing a major update, please ensure it is thoroughly tested instead of forcing users to install a version that isn’t functioning properly.

This is a critical banking app that people rely on every day. While I understand occasional server maintenance, having online banking show “under maintenance” for four consecutive days is unacceptable. One day of maintenance is understandable, but prolonged outages like this are highly disruptive and not what customers expect from a banking service.

Overall, ADCB offers a secure, convenient, and excellent banking experience. Highly recommended for anyone looking for reliable and hassle-free banking in the UAE.

title: Clear Overview, But Needs Better Tracking Features
body:
The app overall is great and easy to use. However, a few improvements would make it even more practical:

* It would be very helpful to have an option to view the total amount spent or received within a selected date range. Currently, it mainly shows individual transactions or basic summaries, but a clear “Total Amount” feature would make tracking much easier.
* It would also be great to add a search/filter option by account or beneficiary. For example, being able to quickly see how much I’ve spent on restaurants, petrol, or a specific vendor would make expense tracking much more efficient.

These features would significantly improve the user experience and financial visibility.

M.J

title: Unusable After Update — Can’t Even Transfer Funds
body:
I don't usually post reviews, but this new app from ADCB has left me no choice.

Since updating, I've had major issues:

- **Slow login and slow loading** throughout the app — checking credit card details or other account info now takes far longer than before.

- **Beneficiaries not showing up**, which means I can't transfer money to my family or friends.

- **"Unauthorized access" errors** when trying to view my beneficiary list, even while logged in.

The previous version of the app was fast, responsive, and reliable. This new version feels like a major downgrade — a modern UI paired with buggy functionality and half-baked AI features that get in the way of basic banking.

I've been an ADCB customer for over 6 years and have watched the app improve over time. It's disappointing to see it take such a step back, especially since these aren't minor glitches — customers can't even complete a basic funds transfer.

ADCB should not have made this update mandatory before thoroughly testing it. I'd urge the team to restore the old app's functionality until these issues are properly fixed.
